facts.fact: ONECI deputy director general Pélagie Gonto said in October 2024 that the national identification number (NNI) is now placed on civil status certificates, and that the number follows each person through civil registration.

ONECI deputy director general Pélagie Gonto said in October 2024 that the Cityweb software is deployed in 434 civil registration centres (303 sub-prefectures and 131 communes), a deployment rate of 62.89%, and that digitisation of civil status registers was piloted at 100% in the Grand-Bassam town hall.
